observables.statement: NCI describes triple-negative breast cancer as about 15% of breast cancers, typically faster-growing and more recurrent than some other invasive subtypes. Descriptor only; not a CONFLUENCE parameter.
Research framing for this profile is a coupled tumour–immune–stroma–metabolism axis under treatment pressure. Axes are a thinking scaffold, not measured couplings in confluence_v2_15d.
OnCo lists LDHA among lactate-metabolism targets (CC BY-NC 4.0). That page is knowledge, not p_lactate.

candidate_mechanisms.statement: Lactate metabolism, TGF-β stroma signalling, immune exclusion and persister states may be coupled loops in metastatic TNBC and can be stated as a testable in-silico mechanism hypothesis.
candidate_mechanisms.falsifier: If a named public-cohort contrast (TCGA-BRCA RNA-seq via GDC) and a named assay fail to support a lactate–exclusion association in the stated context, retire the coupling. Never promote it to p_lactate.

candidate_mechanisms.statement: OnCo LDHA knowledge and confidence.probability can be entered as the confluence_v2_15d parameter p_lactate (or legacy pyruvate_to_lactate).
candidate_mechanisms.falsifier: Rejected a priori: Knowledge is not a parameter.
